rules.principle: Gross margin must be based on revenue minus cost of goods or service delivery, not total sales or GMV.
redFlags: gross margin claim without cost basis
services margin presented as SaaS margin
rules.slideFix: Clarify revenue basis and margin basis. If margin is unknown, request COGS/service delivery assumptions.

rules.principle: CAC should include sales and marketing costs needed to acquire customers over a defined period.
redFlags: CAC based only on ad spend
CAC used before repeatable acquisition exists
rules.slideFix: Label CAC as early/proxy if not mature. Request acquisition cost components and conversion assumptions.

rules.principle: LTV is not credible without retention, churn, gross margin, and average revenue assumptions.
rules.slideFix: Either show LTV calculation assumptions or replace with early retention/usage proxies.

rules.principle: B2B decks should connect CAC, sales cycle, gross margin, and payback period where possible.
rules.slideFix: Add payback-period assumptions or request data before presenting unit economics as proven.

earlyStageProxies: gross margin proxy from delivery cost
